name: Steve
author: pcppcp
description: Steve by pcppcp records a short loop and plays it back as two to four copies. In drift mode the copies run at slightly different speeds, so they slide apart and back together, like Reich's *It's Gonna Rain*. In steps mode the copies jump ahead one unit at a time and lock there, like *Piano Phase*.
credits: From op1r, ported to kennel by Hundekraft
